name: Creditors Report
query:
SELECT pi.name AS "Invoice No:Link/Purchase Invoice:150",
       pi.supplier AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:150",
       pi.propms_property AS "Property:Link/Property:150",
       pi.propms_unit AS "Unit:Link/Unit Master:130",
       GROUP_CONCAT(pid.item_name) AS "Items:Data:200",
       pi.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:100",
       pi.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:100",
       ROUND(IF(pi.currency = "USD", IF(pi.currency = pi.party_account_currency, pi.outstanding_amount, pi.outstanding_amount/pi.conversion_rate), 0),2) AS "USD:Float:100",
       ROUND(IF(pi.currency = "TZS", IF(pi.currency = pi.party_account_currency, pi.outstanding_amount, pi.outstanding_amount*pi.conversion_rate), 0),2) AS "TZS:Float:100",
       pi._user_tags AS "Remarks:Data:200"
FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice Item` AS pid ON pi.name = pid.parent
WHERE pi.status IN ("Submitted", "Unpaid", "Overdue")
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR pi.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR pi.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(property)s IS NULL OR %(property)s = '' OR pi.propms_property = %(property)s)
  AND (%(unit)s IS NULL OR %(unit)s = '' OR pi.propms_unit = %(unit)s)
  AND (%(tenant)s IS NULL OR %(tenant)s = '')
GROUP BY pi.name
